name: Air-Fryer Beetroot Tikki
ingredients: 1 medium beetroot (150 g), grated and squeezed dry
1 green chilli and 1 tsp ginger, minced
½ tsp each cumin, garam masala and amchur
steps: Mix the beetroot, chickpeas, potato, besan, chilli, ginger, spices and salt into a firm mixture.
Shape into 6 flat patties and chill for 10 minutes.
Preheat the air fryer to 180°C. Brush the tikkis lightly with oil.
Cook for 14 minutes, turning halfway, until firm and crisp at the edges.
note: Squeeze the grated beetroot dry or the tikkis will be too wet to hold.
